summary: Before coding, post your proposed plugin and module names with short descriptions on the Ansible Forum so the community can review them for consistency.
questions: Should I get feedback on my module names before writing a collection?
Where do I propose new module names to the community?

answer_card.title: Circulate your collection plan
answer_card.answer_md: Write a list of proposed plugin/module names with short descriptions and post it on the **Ansible Forum** for review. Consistent, familiar names make the collection easier to use.
